text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A strategy meeting was held for the 
Japanese Derby. While her compatibility 
with the racetrack was great, her 
inability to set her own pace during races 
remained a cause for concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, Mejiro Ryan brought Ines Fujin along 
as a tandem training partner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running alongside the one who controlled 
races at her own pace, she set out to 
master her late-race kick and find the 
right moment to make her move—learning 
from the two "elder sisters."
